text:
zoe: quick heads-up — my QA run of examples/go-starter with OTEL_LOG_INJECTION=true shows two odd things: early logs missing request_id (prints `request_id=undefined`) and lots of duplicate `[REDACTED]` entries when redaction is enabled.

omar: yikes. is that the sample pinned to sdk v2.3? any repro steps?

zoe: yes. steps: `git checkout main && cd examples/go-starter && REDWOOD_ENV=staging REDWOOD_API_KEY=xxxx OTEL_LOG_INJECTION=true ./run.sh` then hit /chat a few times. sample's env in .env.example: ```
OTEL_LOG_INJECTION=true
REDWOOD_REDACT_PATTERNS='(api_key|token|secret)'
```

pat: can you paste a raw log fragment?

zoe: raw: `2026-05-10T08:22:11Z INFO http.request path=/chat request_id=undefined user_email=[REDACTED] duration=22ms` then later `2026-05-10T08:22:12Z INFO http.request path=/chat request_id=abc123 user_email=[REDACTED]`

omar: looks like reqid assigned after the first log. probably init ordering: our reqid middleware registers after logger or otel injects logs earlier.

pat: and the double-redact?

zoe: i saw values like `[REDACTED]` then another pass changed something causing logs with repeated bracketed redactions, e.g. `[REDACTED]-[REDACTED]` in some multi-header cases. makes grep for tokens useless.

omar: two quick fixes: 1) make reqid lookup safe so we never stringify nil to "undefined" and prefer `-` or `init` as a default; 2) make redaction idempotent.

pat: implementation idea for redaction: before running regex replace, check `if strings.Contains(val, "[REDACTED]") { return val }` or ensure our regex doesn't match the bracketed form (negative lookbehind). add unit tests for a second-pass run.

zoe: i'll open a PR with a tiny change: in logger/middleware.go replace the cast with safe form: `rid, _ := ctx.Value(reqIDKey).(string); if rid == "" { rid = "init" }` and in redact/redactor.go early-out if value already contains `[REDACTED]`.

omar: also consider making the sample init deterministic in CI: set LOG_INIT_ORDER=deterministic so we catch these startup races. maybe add a smoke runner in examples/ci that greps for `request_id=undefined` and `([REDACTED].*\[REDACTED\])` and fails if present.

pat: small nit: the sample's REDWOOD_REDACT_PATTERNS is overly broad; capture groups and global replaces can alter bracketed placeholders. recommend anchoring patterns to token formats (e.g. `[A-Za-z0-9-_]{24,}`) and explaining this in examples/README troubleshooting.

telemetry-bot: NOTE: created issue #4410 (devex) "go-starter: early logs missing reqid + non-idempotent redactor" by zoe

zoe: thanks bot. i'll attach repro script and a minimal test. tagging @eng-runtime and @devex for awareness, since startup metrics might be affected.

omar: thanks — if you want i can help with the CI smoke test.

pat: one more follow-up: if OTEL injects fields later, our logger should merge fields rather than overwrite. ensure field merging logic is tested when OTEL enabled.

zoe: good point. i'll add a small test that simulates otel writing trace_id after logger and assert final log has both fields intact. PR incoming in 30m :rocket:
